basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old former Jehovah's Witness trying to catch up on the education I missed out on. Currently living in the Midwest, USA, I work part-time as a barista while taking online courses. I'm passionate about social justice and aim to become either a lawyer or a writer. I love hiking and photography, often spending weekends exploring nearby trails. I'm single and value my independence and personal growth. My online activity is usually in the afternoons and late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a high school diploma and am currently pursuing an associate degree in liberal arts. Most of my knowledge comes from self-learning through online courses and reading. I am particularly interested in law, literature, and psychology, and I often participate in online forums to expand my understanding.
